#!/bin/bash
set +e
OUTPUT=/cw/mnt/c/Users/Liv/Documents/ChatGPT/Precision/PrecisionTesting/.runs/scatter-sorted-update-20261108/ops-nn-v910-ScatterAddWithSorted--20261108-01/02_atk_run/atk_output/job-8
mkdir -p "$OUTPUT"
# ATK owns its native log/report/input/output layout.  Point that layout at
# this job's isolated directory; exporting before setup also lets task setup
# scripts place their auxiliary artifacts in the same directory.
export ATK_TASK_OUTPUT_PATH="$OUTPUT"
if test -f "$OUTPUT/queue_result.json"; then
  printf 'launch suppressed by queue cancellation intent
' >&2
  exit 125
fi
rm -f "$OUTPUT/atk_task.exit_code" "$OUTPUT/atk_task.exit_code.tmp"
printf '%s\n' ptq_dcde1a8de6b13b34_scatter-sorted-v4-step0-infer-20261109-01_dev2_slot0_3b6389fe > "$OUTPUT/atk_task.attempt"
date -Iseconds > "$OUTPUT/atk_task.started.tmp"
mv "$OUTPUT/atk_task.started.tmp" "$OUTPUT/atk_task.started"

write_result() {
  code="$1"
  stage="$2"
  printf '%s
' "$stage" > "$OUTPUT/atk_task.stage.tmp"
  mv "$OUTPUT/atk_task.stage.tmp" "$OUTPUT/atk_task.stage"
  printf '%s
' "$code" > "$OUTPUT/atk_task.exit_code.tmp"
  mv "$OUTPUT/atk_task.exit_code.tmp" "$OUTPUT/atk_task.exit_code"
  exit "$code"
}

ENV_SCRIPT=
for candidate in /usr/local/Ascend/cann-9.1.0/set_env.sh /usr/local/Ascend/ascend-toolkit/set_env.sh; do
  if test -f "$candidate"; then
    ENV_SCRIPT="$candidate"
    break
  fi
done
if test -z "$ENV_SCRIPT"; then
  printf 'CANN environment setup script not found
' > "$OUTPUT/environment_setup.stderr"
  : > "$OUTPUT/environment_setup.stdout"
  write_result 1 environment
fi
source "$ENV_SCRIPT" > "$OUTPUT/environment_setup.stdout" 2> "$OUTPUT/environment_setup.stderr"
ENV_EXIT=$?
if test "$ENV_EXIT" -ne 0; then
  printf 'environment setup failed with exit code %s
' "$ENV_EXIT" >> "$OUTPUT/environment_setup.stderr"
  write_result "$ENV_EXIT" environment
fi

if test -f /cw/mnt/c/Users/Liv/Documents/ChatGPT/Precision/PrecisionTesting/.runs/scatter-sorted-update-20261108/ops-nn-v910-ScatterAddWithSorted--20261108-01/02_atk_run/atk_runnable/setup_defective.sh; then
  bash /cw/mnt/c/Users/Liv/Documents/ChatGPT/Precision/PrecisionTesting/.runs/scatter-sorted-update-20261108/ops-nn-v910-ScatterAddWithSorted--20261108-01/02_atk_run/atk_runnable/setup_defective.sh > "$OUTPUT/setup_defective.stdout" 2> "$OUTPUT/setup_defective.stderr"
  SETUP_EXIT=$?
  if test "$SETUP_EXIT" -ne 0; then
    printf 'setup failed with exit code %s
' "$SETUP_EXIT" >> "$OUTPUT/setup_defective.stderr"
    write_result "$SETUP_EXIT" setup
  fi
else
  : > "$OUTPUT/setup_defective.stdout"
  : > "$OUTPUT/setup_defective.stderr"
fi

python3 - <<'PYACL' > "$OUTPUT/acl_self_check.stdout" 2> "$OUTPUT/acl_self_check.stderr"
import acl
import sys

init_ret = acl.init()
count_result = acl.rt.get_device_count()
count, count_ret = count_result if isinstance(count_result, tuple) else (0, count_result)
set_ret = acl.rt.set_device(0) if init_ret == 0 and count_ret == 0 and count > 0 else -1
sync_ret = acl.rt.synchronize_device() if set_ret == 0 else -1
reset_ret = acl.rt.reset_device(0) if set_ret == 0 else -1
print({"init": init_ret, "count": count, "count_ret": count_ret,
       "set_ret": set_ret, "sync_ret": sync_ret, "reset_ret": reset_ret})
ok = init_ret == count_ret == set_ret == sync_ret == reset_ret == 0 and count > 0
raise SystemExit(0 if ok else 1)
PYACL
ACL_EXIT=$?
if test "$ACL_EXIT" -ne 0; then
  printf 'ACL self-check failed with exit code %s
' "$ACL_EXIT" >> "$OUTPUT/acl_self_check.stderr"
  write_result "$ACL_EXIT" acl
fi

# ATK creates its native atk_output tree below the current directory.
# Running from the isolated job output keeps concurrent results disjoint and
# lets the normal output synchronizer copy every remote artifact.
cd "$OUTPUT"
cp /cw/mnt/c/Users/Liv/Documents/ChatGPT/Precision/PrecisionTesting/.runs/scatter-sorted-update-20261108/ops-nn-v910-ScatterAddWithSorted--20261108-01/02_atk_run/atk_runnable/node.yaml "$OUTPUT/node.snapshot.yaml" || write_result 1 nodes
atk task --task accuracy --case /cw/mnt/c/Users/Liv/Documents/ChatGPT/Precision/PrecisionTesting/.runs/scatter-sorted-update-20261108/ops-nn-v910-ScatterAddWithSorted--20261108-01/02_atk_run/atk_input/test_suite.template.atk.json --plugin_path /cw/mnt/c/Users/Liv/Documents/ChatGPT/Precision/PrecisionTesting/.runs/scatter-sorted-update-20261108/ops-nn-v910-ScatterAddWithSorted--20261108-01/02_atk_run/atk_runnable --nodes /cw/mnt/c/Users/Liv/Documents/ChatGPT/Precision/PrecisionTesting/.runs/scatter-sorted-update-20261108/ops-nn-v910-ScatterAddWithSorted--20261108-01/02_atk_run/atk_output/job-8/node.snapshot.yaml --save_data output:bin --log info \
